mapper.select: select o.*, coalesce((select sum(od.total_amount) from order_detail od where od.order_id = o.order_id), 0) as total_amount from orders o order by o.order_id desc
select o.*, coalesce((select sum(od.total_amount) from order_detail od where od.order_id = o.order_id), 0) as total_amount from orders o where o.customer_id = #{customerId} order by o.order_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into orders ( order_no, order_date, customer_id, shipping_requirement, supply_flag, shipping_date, total_weight, freight, payment_status, receiver, phone, address, invoice_flag, payment_method ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{orderDate}, #{customerId}, #{shippingRequirement}, #{supplyFlag}, #{shippingDate}, #{totalWeight}, #{freight}, #{paymentStatus}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{invoiceFlag}, #{paymentMethod} )
mapper.select: select * from orders where payment_status = '3' order by order_id desc
select * from orders where payment_status = '0' order by order_id desc
select * from orders where payment_status = '1' order by order_id desc
select * from orders where supply_flag = 'N' order by order_id desc
